verdict.rationale: smolagents ships a well-documented Python API (guided tour, tutorials for tools/memory/multiagents, agent.push_to_hub/from_hub) plus CLI utilities, all covered in first-party HuggingFace docs and GitHub README, making it straightforward for an AI-native user to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of API stability and a dedicated formal API reference beyond guided tour/tutorials.
